title: Grandfather's garden parrot, her uncles, and learning piano as a toddler
summary: The parrot guarding the garden and ordering wood, her uncles and fair-skinned family who could pass, and how she taught herself piano at three.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth
